ValidationRule.description: Prevents Sales users from creating downsell or cancellation amendments. Only Customer Operations can process these amendment types.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Quote_Type__c, 'Amendment'), OR( ISPICKVAL(Amendment_Reason__c, 'Downsell'), ISPICKVAL(Amendment_Reason__c, 'Full Cancellation') ), NOT(CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, 'Customer Ops')), NOT(CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, 'Operations')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Downsell and Cancellation amendments can only be created by Customer Operations. Please contact Customer Operations for assistance.
